---

## Owning record or surface

Identify the exact observation, evidence record, baseline file, schema,
analysis, metadata surface, or public claim.

## Prior state

State the prior value or interpretation without deleting its historical context.

## New evidence

Provide:

- source locator
- retrieval timestamp
- platform
- object ID where applicable
- evidence reference
- observed response/state

## Correction type

- [ ] raw evidence reference correction
- [ ] normalized/derived observation correction
- [ ] interpretation correction
- [ ] baseline reconciliation
- [ ] platform/layer mapping correction
- [ ] scholarly metadata correction
- [ ] amendment/deviation required

## Historical preservation

Explain how the prior record remains traceable.

## Downstream impact

List any analysis, conclusion, release, or citation surface that may require
reconciliation.

## Unresolved state

Record any remaining `UNKNOWN`, `PARTIAL`, `RATE_LIMITED`, or other
non-final state explicitly.
